title: Testing the RX 9070 XT at 4K Path Tracing in Cyberpunk 2077!
description:
Cyberpunk 2077 running on the AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB graphics card at 4K resolution using ultra graphics settings and path tracing. In this video, Benchmark Boy will display benchmark performance stats including fps, framerate, core clocks, power consumption, temperatures and much more! These benchmarks will help you make your next pc hardware buying decisions.
